ui.intentNormal: Next turn: attack ({d} damage if you miss)
ui.intentBig: Heavy attack incoming! Only Defend blocks it ({d} damage)
ui.figNote: The figure is not drawn to scale.

msg.solve: Solve the question to attack. There is no time limit.
msg.correctWeak: Correct! You hit its weak point. {d} damage
msg.wrong: Wrong! Check the answer and the solution.
msg.solveGuard: Answer correctly to block the attack completely and counter.
msg.guardFail: Not blocked: you took half damage. Check the answer and the solution.
msg.bigHit: Your attack landed, but the heavy attack hit you. Only Defend can block a heavy attack. ({d} damage)
msg.solveChain: Answer the parts in order. A wrong answer ends the chain.
msg.chainNext: Correct! {d} damage. On to the next part.
msg.midSpring: You drank from the spring before the mid-boss room. HP +{n}

map.title: Crossroads map
map.tip: Pick a starting space from the gate. You can only climb along the paths.

node.eventSub: Could be good, could be bad
node.midbossSub: A strong enemy you must pass

ev.restText: Take a rest, or review a question you missed?
ev.restReviewSub: Retry a type you missed for a bonus
ev.restSlept: You rested well and recovered {n} HP.
ev.reviewText: Answer correctly to get 1 hint and {n} HP.
ev.reviewOk: Correct! You got 1 hint and {n} HP.
ev.treasureText: Answer correctly to open the chest.
ev.treasureOk: The chest opened. You got {gold}G and 1 hint.
ev.treasureFail: The lock held, but you picked up {gold}G from the floor. {explain}
ev.clearText: You defeated the boss. You have cleared this unit {n} time(s).
ev.overText: You fell on floor {n} of {total}. Your gold and upgrades are gone, but your codex record stays. Pick your range again and start on a new map.
ev.restUsed: You have already used this rest stop.
ev.treasureUsed: You already tried this chest. Its lock is now shut tight.
ev.treasureOkRelic: The chest opens. You get {gold}G and a relic.
ev.rewardTextRelic: You get {gold}G and a relic. Choose one upgrade.

codex.title: Codex
codex.toDone: {n} more in a row to master
codex.unseenLeft: {n} monsters are still waiting to be met.
codex.relicLeft: {n} relics are still waiting to be found.

tut.start: Tap a space in the bottom row to set out. A battle will begin.
tut.basic: Tap Attack. You will get an easy question.
tut.answer: In the tutorial the right answer is shown. Tap the glowing answer to attack.
tut.skill: Now try Skill. The question is harder but the damage is bigger.
tut.defend: Tap Defend to block the heavy attack.
tut.guard: Tap the glowing answer to block the heavy attack and counter.
tut.free: Now fight freely. Three correct answers in a row charge your ultimate.
tut.ult: The gauge is full. Tap Special for big damage with no question.
tut.reward: After a win you choose one upgrade. It lasts until this map ends.
tut.map: Choose your next space from those joined by a line.
tut.look1: This is the enemy’s name and HP. The yellow tag is its weakness: a correct answer of that type deals 1.5 times the damage.
tut.look2: This shows what the enemy will do next turn. If you answer wrongly, you take the damage written here.
tut.look3: This is your HP and your special gauge. Three correct answers in a row fill the gauge.
tut.warn: A red warning means a heavy attack. It hits even if you answer correctly; only Defend blocks it.
tut.chain: This is Chain. You answer parts (1), (2), (3) about one situation. Each correct answer hits harder, and a wrong answer ends it. You can use it once per battle.
tut.skipped: Tutorial skipped. Pick a space to start.

spring.title: Clear spring
spring.text: You drink from a clear spring and recover {n} HP.

fog.title: Thick fog
fog.text: You lose your way in the fog and take a fall. You lose {n} HP.

purse.title: Dropped purse
purse.text: You find a purse with no owner in sight. You gain {n}G.

thief.title: Pickpocket
thief.text: Someone brushes past you. {n}G is gone.

note.title: Surveyor's note
note.text: You find a note left by an older surveyor. You gain {n} hint.

statue.title: Strange statue
statue.text: The statue wants to ask you a question. Answer right for an upgrade; answer wrong and lose {n} HP.
statue.trySub: Hard question · wrong answer costs {n} HP
statue.ok: The statue steps aside. You got {name}. ({desc})
statue.fail: The statue scolds you. You lose {n} HP. {explain}

ambush.title: Ambush
ambush.text: A monster jumps out of the bushes!

weaknote.title: Weak-point note
weaknote.text: You pick up a note describing the enemy's weak point. In the next battle, your first {n} attack questions are the enemy's weak type.

board.title: Old blackboard
board.text: An old blackboard stands by the road with one question on it. Answer right for {n} hints. A wrong answer costs nothing.
board.trySub: Hard question · right answer gives {n} hints
board.ok: A note drops from behind the board. You gain {n} hints.
board.fail: Too bad, but you lose nothing. {explain}

bet.title: Gambler
bet.text: A gambler offers a bet on a question. Stake {n}G: answer right and you get the stake back plus {win}G. Answer wrong and the stake is gone.
bet.ok: You win the bet. You get your {n}G back and {win}G more.
bet.fail: You lose the bet and your {n}G. {explain}

dojo.title: Training hall
dojo.text: An old training hall. Spend {n} HP on a workout to gain one upgrade. You can pick only one.
dojo.ok: You train and spend {n} HP. You got {name}. ({desc})

peddler.title: Wandering merchant
peddler.text: A wandering merchant unpacks. One relic is for sale at {n}G. (You have {gold}G)
peddler.empty: A wandering merchant unpacks, but has nothing to sell.

locker.title: Forgotten locker
locker.text: A forgotten locker. Put in one of your relics and a different relic of the same rarity comes out. You cannot tell which. Choose a relic to put in.
locker.empty: A forgotten locker. You have no relic you can put in.
locker.ok: You put in {old} and a different relic comes out.

bench.title: Resting bench
bench.text: A bench under a street lamp. Choose how to rest.
bench.healOk: You take a short nap and recover {n} HP.
bench.maxOk: You stretch slowly. Max HP goes up by {n}.

title.startSub: Pick your range and set out on a new map.
title.restartSub: Pick the range again and set out on a new map.
title.confirm: Your current map will be lost. (Floor {n} of {total} · HP {hp}/{max} · {gold}G) Your codex records are kept.
title.codexSub: Monsters you met and your record by type
title.note: Progress is saved on this device automatically. Your codex record stays even if you start over.
title.tutorialSub: Start a new map with the guide from the beginning.
title.dataSub: Back up your records, home-screen help, erase
title.iosHint: On iPhone your records can be erased
title.iosHintSub: Safari clears them after about a week away. See how to keep them →

scope.title: Choose your range
scope.text: Pick the question types for this run. Focus on the ones you find hard, or choose widely so you never know what is coming.
scope.chainOff: No linked questions in this range (choose every type of one set to get them)

menu.title: Paused
menu.textMap: Your progress is saved automatically. You can come back with "Continue".
menu.textBattle: If you leave now, this battle restarts from the beginning. Your HP and hints are saved as they are. There is no time limit, so you can also just leave the screen as it is.
menu.textEvent: If you leave now, this space restarts from the beginning. The rest of your progress is saved.

opt.basekeep: is greater than 1, so the inequality keeps its direction
opt.baseflip: is less than 1, so the inequality reverses
opt.reject: Chance is an unlikely explanation; we can judge that it works
opt.keep: This could happen by chance; we cannot judge that it works
opt.surely: It is proven that it always works
opt.never: It is proven that it does not work

data.title: Data
data.intro: This game keeps your records only on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
data.summary: Battles won {wins} · Towers cleared {clears} · Types mastered {done}
data.backupText: Export your records as a text code and keep it. You can continue on another device or in the home-screen app.
data.exported: Your code is ready. Copy it or save it as a file.
data.copied: Copied. Paste it into a note or a message to keep it.
data.badCode: This code could not be read. Check that you pasted all of it.
data.importText:
The records on this device will be lost and replaced by the imported ones.

Imported: Battles won {wins} · Towers cleared {clears} · Types mastered {done}
data.iosTitle: Add this game to your Home Screen
data.iosText: Safari on iPhone automatically erases the records of sites you have not visited for a while (7 days of Safari use). Apps added to the Home Screen are not erased.
data.iosSteps: How: tap the Share button at the bottom (a square with an arrow) → "Add to Home Screen" → "Add"
data.iosMove: Records made in Safari may not carry over to the Home Screen app. Use "Export records" above to copy your code, then "Import records" in the Home Screen app.
data.otherText: Choose "Add to Home screen" (or "Install app") in your browser menu to use this like an app. Clearing browsing or site data in your browser also erases the game records, so export them first.
data.eraseText: When you stop playing you can erase what is left on this device. Erased data cannot be recovered.
data.resetSub: Erases only your progress and codex. The game still works.
data.wipeSub: Erases your records and the offline files from this device.
data.resetText: Your current map, your codex and your tutorial status will be erased. This cannot be undone. Language and sound settings are kept.
data.wipeText: Your records and the offline files will be erased from this device. This cannot be undone.
data.wipedText: Nothing is left on this device. Close this tab and you are done. If you added an icon to your Home Screen, please remove it yourself.

bless.title: The Keeper's Gift
bless.textEarly: You fell on floor {n} last time. Let me help a little this time. Choose one.
bless.textFar: You climbed to floor {n} last time. A gift for climbing again. Choose one.
bless.textClear: You conquered the tower and came back. A gift for climbing again. Choose one.
bless.frailSub: Enemies have 1 HP in your first {frail} battles (not the mid-boss or boss)

ascend.name: Challenge level
ascend.opened: Challenge level {n} is unlocked. You can change it on the range screen.
ascend.l2: Level 2: more elite spaces, and elites have +25% HP
ascend.l4: Level 4: start with no hints, half healing after a win
ascend.l5: Level 5: mid-boss and boss have +15% HP, heavy attacks deal +2
ascend.l6: Level 6: normal attacks deal a further +1 and wins no longer heal. In the boss fight you fill in the digits yourself instead of choosing (numeric answers only)

cheer.text: Cheer level {n}: until you clear the tower you also get Max HP +{hp} and take {pct}% less damage.
cheer.name: Cheer

set.title: Settings
set.calmSub: Turns off shaking, flashing and screen transitions.
set.cheerSub: If you keep falling before clearing the tower, you get more HP and take less damage. Turn it off to always play on the same terms.

tip.label: First visit
tip.shop: In the shop you buy upgrades with the gold you earned in battle. Buy several, or leave without buying.
tip.rest: At a rest stop you choose one of the two. Resting heals a lot; a correct review question gives a hint and a little HP.
tip.treasure: A treasure chest gives gold and a hint for a correct answer. A wrong answer does no damage and still gives a little gold. A chest you have seen cannot be opened again.
tip.event: On a ? space something good or bad happens. You only find out by going in.
tip.relic: A relic works on its own until this run ends. Tap the relic row at the top to see your bag.

act.nextText: Boss defeated. You gained {gold} gold and recovered {hp} HP. {left} acts remain, counting this one. Your gold and upgrades carry over.
act.lastText: Boss defeated. You gained {gold} gold and recovered {hp} HP. This is the final act. Your gold and upgrades carry over.

bag.name: Heavy Bag
bag.text:
Max HP +{hp}
▼ Heal {n} less after battles

relic.barLabel: {n} relics. Tap to open the bag
relic.none: No relics left, so you received {gold}G instead.
relic.chooseText: Pick one. You may also skip.

notebook.name: New notebook
notebook.text: Start each battle with +{n} streak (The Restarter only)

dogear.name: Dog-eared textbook
dogear.text: Once per battle, a wrong answer does not break your streak (The Restarter only)

kneepad.name: Knee pads
kneepad.text: +{n} HP when a guard succeeds (Captain Grit only)

sneakers.name: Worn sneakers
sneakers.text: Block a heavy attack and your next special deals +{n} damage (Captain Grit only)

stopwatch.name: Stopwatch
stopwatch.text: After a special, your next right answer deals +{n} damage (Lightning Abacus only)

flashmemo.name: Lightning memo
flashmemo.text: With a streak of {need} or more, basic attacks deal +{n} damage (Lightning Abacus only)

pencil.name: Worn Pencil
pencil.text: First correct answer each battle deals +{n} damage

eraser.name: Eraser
eraser.text: First wrong answer each battle: take only {n}% damage

grid.name: Graph Paper
grid.text: Correct answers on questions with a figure deal +{n} damage

snack.name: Snack Pouch
snack.text: Heal +{n} HP after winning a battle

note.name: Senior's Note
note.text: Gain 1 hint on entering each new room (while you have fewer than {n})

setsquare.name: Set Square
setsquare.text: Counterattacks after a successful guard deal +{n} damage

bookmark.name: Bookmark
bookmark.text: Start each battle with a streak of {n}

ribbon.name: Streak Ribbon
ribbon.text: Every {n} correct answers in a row, block the next damage once

wrongnote.name: Mistake Notebook
wrongnote.text: After a wrong answer, your next correct answer deals +{n} damage

alarm.name: Alarm Clock
alarm.text: Enemy heavy attacks come every {n} turns (was {was})

library.name: Library Card
library.text: +{n} gold for a correct answer on a type you have not mastered

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.text: Once per run, survive a fatal blow with {n} HP

chainbelt.name: Chain Belt
chainbelt.text: Use Chain {n} times per battle. Each chain step deals +{dmg} damage

workbook.name: Thick Workbook
workbook.text:
Ultimate deals +{n} damage
▼ Ultimate needs {need} more correct answer in a row

hero.pickText: Which form will climb the tower? You gain a new form each time you clear it.
hero.locked: Clear the tower {clears} time(s) to unlock
hero.gainedText: You can choose this form from your next run.

starter.name: The Restarter
starter.ability: No special ability. The basic rules
starter.story: The kid who gave up on math picked up the pencil again.
starter.ultMsg: One more time! {d} damage, and you recover {n} HP.

grit.name: Captain Grit
grit.ability: After a successful guard, your next correct answer deals +{n} damage
grit.story: The kid who kept retrying became Captain Grit.
grit.ultMsg: Stand and strike! {d} damage. The next hit on you is blocked.

flash.name: Lightning Abacus
flash.story: After two towers, the kid calculates as fast as lightning.
flash.ultMsg: Lightning flurry! Two hits for {d} damage.

key.name: Keys
key.title: Keys to the true boss
key.text: Collect all three keys and, after the final boss, the true boss waits at the deepest part of the tower. You get a key by giving up a reward.

rest.name: Key of Rest
rest.where: At a rest room, instead of resting
rest.sub: Get the key without resting or reviewing
rest.got: You took the Key of Rest instead of resting.

relic.name: Key of Treasure
relic.where: From an elite or a chest, instead of a relic
relic.sub: Get the key instead of the relic

win.name: Key of Victory
win.where: After the mid-boss, instead of a relic
win.sub: Get the key instead of choosing a relic

key.doorText: You cleared the tower. But the three keys point to a deeper door. Beyond it are the Shadow Stairs: after a rest stop and a shop, the {gate} blocks the way, and behind it waits the {name}. Even if you lose, your clear still counts.
key.gateText: The door opens. You catch your breath and heal {hp} HP. Now for the {name}.
key.won: And you defeated the {name}. (True boss defeated {n} time(s))
key.lost: You lost to the {name}, but your clear still counts.
